golden_repeat_items.question: What are common reasons a bank triggers a chargeback on Getnet, and what happens with card-not-present sales even if the merchant proves the transaction?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Common chargeback reasons include goods not received or defective, the cardholder not recognizing the transaction, duplicate processing, a refund not being processed, or the customer having paid by another method. A chargeback means the bank cancels the transaction and debits the merchant. Getnet says card-not-present sales can still be cancelled even if the merchant proves the transaction; the FAQ does not explain why or provide further conditions or dispute steps.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly on the listed chargeback reasons and correctly states that card-not-present sales can still be cancelled even if the merchant proves the transaction. The added explanation that the FAQ does not give further details is supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: A Get Conta oferece cartão virtual grátis e antecipação de recebíveis? Quais tipos de documento são aceitos no cadastro e em quais lojas de aplicativos o app Getnet Brasil está disponível?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Sim. A Get Conta oferece cartão virtual grátis e acesso à antecipação de recebíveis. O cadastro é feito com CPF (pessoa física) ou CNPJ (empresa); não encontrei confirmação de outros documentos aceitos. O app Getnet Brasil está disponível no Google Play e na App Store.

A página consultada não detalha taxas, prazos ou critérios da antecipação; consulte as condições no app Getnet ou no Portal Minha Conta.

Sources:
- https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on all required points: free virtual card, receivables advance, CPF/CNPJ as accepted registration documents, and availability on Google Play and App Store. Getnet no publica un horario límite diario ni una tarifa exacta para la anticipación de ventas. Para consultar las condiciones y tasas específicas de tu comercio, revisa la simulación en la app de Getnet o en Portal Minha Conta. Las tasas de otros planes publicadas en la FAQ no corresponden a la tarifa de antecipação.

- https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o faturamento mensal mínimo necessário para ter isenção do aluguel da maquininha Get Clássica?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
As páginas oficiais divergem: a página específica da Get Clássica informa isenção com faturamento de R$ 10 mil por mês, enquanto a página geral de maquininhas informa R$ 20 mil por mês. Vendas de voucher (VA/VR) e Crediário não contam para a isenção, segundo a página específica. Como há essa divergência, confirme qual limite se aplica no simulador ou diretamente com a Getnet. Se o mínimo não for atingido, as páginas informam aluguel de R$ 79,90 por mês.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the evidence and reference: it states the conflicting thresholds (R$ 10 mil vs R$ 20 mil), notes voucher/crediário exclusions, and advises confirming the applicable limit with the simulator or Getnet. It also correctly mentions the R$ 79,90 rental if the minimum is not reached.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é a razão social e o banco (nome, código e final da conta) cadastrados no meu perfil, e quais são as taxas de crédito parcelado em 6x e 9x na Get Clássica?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
A razão social cadastrada é **Bistrô Moinhos de Vento S.A.**. O banco é **Banco Itaú**, código **341**, e a conta termina em **04-2**.

Na Get Clássica, as taxas publicadas “a partir de” para crédito parcelado são **9,94% em 6x** e **11,41% em 9x**. São taxas únicas para Mastercard, Visa, Elo e Amex. A oferta é para novos clientes e está sujeita à análise cadastral; clientes Getnet existentes devem simular as taxas no app Getnet.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

golden_repeat_items.answer:

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuánto puede variar el plazo para recibir una venta hecha con ese medio, y cuántas claves permite para personas físicas y para empresas?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
El plazo para recibir una venta hecha con Pix puede variar hasta **1 día corrido**, según el modelo Pix para el que seas elegible y la hora en que se apruebe la venta. Getnet lo promociona como recepción «en segundos», pero el plazo puede variar hasta ese día.

Se permiten hasta **5 claves Pix por cuenta para personas físicas** y **20 para empresas**.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

judge.rationale: La respuesta coincide con la referencia: indica que el plazo puede variar hasta 1 día corrido y que hay 5 claves para personas físicas y 20 para empresas. Todo está respaldado por la evidencia de la página de Pix de Getnet.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
O diagnóstico do terminal Get Smart POS-GS-99812 indica dessincronização recorrente da chave criptográfica do PIN-pad, associada à recusa do pagamento de R$ 430,00 (TX-88410), com o código ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE / POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN.

O rekeying remoto do PIN-pad foi aprovado. A ordem de serviço SO-D9E42AB2 foi criada e encaminhada para execução, prevista para ocorrer em até 2 horas. O serviço ainda não foi realizado.

golden_repeat_items.question: What does the Getnet FAQ recommend for charging the Get Smart battery (when to charge, for how long, and what to avoid), and what are the different ways to power a Getnet card machine on or off?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The Getnet FAQ recommends charging the Get Smart when its battery reaches 20%, for at least 3 hours continuously, and avoiding letting it fully discharge.

To power a Getnet card machine on or off, the FAQ lists these methods, depending on the model: use the green key, the up-arrow key, the plug, or hold the green/red key for 5 seconds. It does not specify which method applies to each model or distinguish which method is for turning it on versus off.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer exactly matches the FAQ guidance in the evidence: charge at 20%, for at least 3 hours, and do not let it fully discharge; and the power methods listed are green key, up-arrow key, plug, or holding the green/red key for 5 seconds. It also correctly notes that the source does not map each method to a specific model or on/off direction.

golden_repeat_items.question: Quando eu escolho receber pela Get Conta, em quanto tempo e em qual período do dia o pagamento cai? Além disso, quais são os canais de autoatendimento da Getnet e qual é o horário de atendimento ao cliente?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Ao escolher receber pela Get Conta, o pagamento cai em até 2 dias úteis, no período da manhã. A Getnet não informa um horário exato.

Os canais de autoatendimento são o Portal Minha Conta e o aplicativo Getnet Brasil. O atendimento ao cliente funciona das 06h às 22h. Por telefone: 4002-4000 ou 4003-4000 (capitais e regiões metropolitanas) e 0800-648-8000 (demais localidades); também há WhatsApp para clientes no 11 97694-6815.

Fontes:
https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/
https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on all requested facts: Get Conta payments arrive in up to 2 business days in the morning, self-service channels are Portal Minha Conta and the Getnet Brasil app, and customer service runs from 06h to 22h. The extra contact details are also supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: With Getnet Crediário, who decides the maximum installment term and interest rate and approves the sale, how does the merchant get paid (timing and whether it arrives in a single lump sum), and do Crediário sales count toward the card machine rental waiver?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
With Getnet Crediário, the card issuer sets the maximum installment term and interest rate and approves the transaction. Crediário can be offered in up to 48 installments; the card-machine simulation shows the interest. After the sale is captured, you are paid within up to 2 business days in a single payment, regardless of the number of installments, net of the discount rate. Crediário sales do not count toward the card machine rental waiver.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on all requested points: the card issuer decides the term and rate and approves the sale, payout is within up to 2 business days in a single lump sum net of the discount rate, and Crediário sales do not count toward the rental waiver. Every claim is supported by the evidence.

Na Get Smart, o Modo Quiosque mantém a tela sempre ligada e executa um app por vez. Ele é protegido por senha e é indicado para totens de autoatendimento.

golden_repeat_items.question: On Getnet's official Pix page, what are the step-by-step activation instructions for Pix and what are the published Pix transaction fees?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The official Pix page does not provide step-by-step activation instructions or publish Pix transaction fees. Its only activation-related advice is to keep your registration details with Getnet up to date. It lists ways to accept Pix—by approximation, biometrics, Get Tap on a phone, or QR Code on a card machine—and says Pix is available through card machines, payment link, Get Tap, e-commerce, and TEF; these are acceptance methods, not activation steps.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference: it says the page does not provide activation steps or fee values and notes the only advice is to keep registration data up to date. It is fully supported by the evidence, though the source URL is extra.

golden_repeat_items.question: And how do I install it in the card machine?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Turn the machine off, open the back cover, and insert the Algar SIM into the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2 with the metal side facing down. Close the cover and turn the machine back on; wait until the 2G or 3G network appears. The power button and slot location vary by model. Getnet’s FAQ does not specify model-by-model compatibility.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer gives the documented installation steps and the 2G/3G readiness cue from the evidence. It adds that power-button and slot location vary by model and that compatibility is unspecified, which is supported by the evidence, and it stays focused on the merchant’s question.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
Se aprobó el re-key remoto del PIN-pad de la maquininha POS-GS-99812. Se creó la orden de servicio SO-FC88EAD3 y el trabajo está programado para ejecutarse dentro de las próximas 2 horas de hoy; todavía no se ha realizado.

golden_repeat_items.question: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Both are POS terminals with 3G and Wi‑Fi, and the published card rates are the same: debit 1.69%, and installments from 2x to 12x at rates ranging from 7.98% to 12.88% depending on the term.

- **Get Clássica** is the simpler, classic POS option. Published rent is **R$79.90/month** if the sales minimum is not met.
- **Get Smart** is a 5-in-1 terminal: payment device, barcode reader, camera, printer and integrated management system. It also offers GetStore with 150+ solutions, Kiosk mode for self-service, POS TEF Digital integration, split-payment features and support for up to five devices in one store. Published rent is **R$129.90/month** if the sales minimum is not met.

In short, Clássica is the simpler, lower-rent option for card acceptance; Smart adds business apps and checkout, self-service and split-payment features. Getnet’s pages list conflicting monthly sales thresholds for waiving rent, so confirm the applicable threshold with Getnet or in its simulator.

Sources:
- https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on the key differences: same 3G+Wi‑Fi and card rates, Clássica as the simpler POS, and Smart as the feature-rich 5‑in‑1 device with the listed extras. It also gives the published rental prices and a useful next step about the conflicting waiver threshold, which is supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet’s published information does not clearly confirm whether you need an external bank account to receive Pix sales. It does say you can receive payments into Get Conta; its opening instructions request a CPF (individual) or CNPJ (company) and do not state that an account at another bank is required. The information does not establish the requirements for other payout destinations.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/
https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference: it says the Pix page does not clearly state whether an external bank account is required, and notes that Get Conta can receive payments and that another-bank requirements are not stated. All claims are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Your Get Smart is offline because its mobile-data session has stalled. Try these steps in order:

1. Restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator.
2. If store Wi-Fi is available, connect the terminal to it.
3. Turn the terminal off, reseat the SIM chip, then turn it back on.
4. Run a communication test: press the function key (F, #, or another key depending on the model), press 60, then choose option 2 (maintenance) and option 1 (communication test).

If it remains offline on both mobile data and Wi-Fi after these steps, ask for a human specialist to help with a chip or terminal swap.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/ (communication-test and chip guidance); internal support runbook (connectivity troubleshooting guidance).

judge.rationale: The answer matches the telemetry-backed troubleshooting sequence: restart, try Wi‑Fi, reseat the SIM with the terminal off, run the communication test, and escalate for a chip or terminal swap if still offline. It stays on connectivity only and does not rely on unsupported claims.

golden_repeat_items.question: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet’s public information confirms that receivables advance is available as a feature of Get Conta, managed through the Getnet Brasil app. However, it does not explain in text how the advance works or publish its eligibility rules, timing, fees, or full request and approval steps. For your specific conditions and rates, Getnet directs merchants to simulate them in the app or Portal Minha Conta, or contact support.

The FAQ’s rates for standard settlement plans are not advance fees, so they shouldn’t be used to estimate the cost of an advance.

Sources:
- https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference: it says the public help page is text-limited, identifies Get Conta/app access, and directs merchants to simulate conditions in the app/Portal Minha Conta or contact support. It also correctly warns not to treat the published FAQ settlement rates as antecipação fees.

golden_repeat_items.question: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Yes. Getnet Payment Link lets you sell through WhatsApp without a card machine. Create a link in Portal Minha Conta or in the Getnet Brasil app under Produtos e Serviços > Link de Pagamento > Criar Link de Pagamento. Add the product details, shipping if applicable, and payment options, then share or copy the link and send it to your customer on WhatsApp.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it says Payment Link is for selling through WhatsApp without a card machine and that the merchant creates and shares a link. All claims are supported by the evidence, including the workflow in Portal Minha Conta or the Getnet Brasil app.

golden_repeat_items.question: It is still offline after I restarted it. What else can I try?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Since restarting didn’t help, try these remaining steps in order:

1. If Wi‑Fi is available, connect the Get Smart to your store’s Wi‑Fi.
2. Turn the machine off. Open the back cover, reseat the SIM in the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2 with the metal side down, close the cover, and turn it back on. Wait for the 2G/3G network indicator.
3. Run a communication test: press the function key (F, #, or another key depending on the model), press 60, choose option 2 (maintenance), then option 1 (communication test).

If it remains offline on both mobile data and Wi‑Fi after these steps, ask me and I can hand the case to a human specialist to review a possible chip or terminal swap.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/; internal://support-runbook

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: Wi‑Fi, reseating the SIM with the terminal off, running the communication test, and escalation for a possible chip or terminal swap if still offline. Every claim is supported by the evidence.

My card machine won't connect to the internet.
It is still offline after I restarted it. What else can I try?
Your Get Smart is offline because its mobile-data session has stalled (status `OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT`). Try these steps in order:

1. Restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator.
2. If store Wi-Fi is available, connect the terminal to it.
3. Turn the terminal off, reseat the SIM, then turn it back on.
4. Run a communication test: press the function key (F, #, or another key depending on the model), press 60, choose 2 (maintenance), then 1 (communication test).

If it remains offline on both mobile data and Wi-Fi after these steps, ask and I can hand this case to a human specialist to review a possible chip or terminal swap.

Sources: internal://support-runbook; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

golden_repeat_items.question: And when do I receive the money from those sales?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Crediário sales are paid in a single payment, regardless of the number of installments, within up to 2 business days after the transaction is captured, less the discount rate.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o aluguel mensal da Get Smart?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
O aluguel mensal da Get Smart é de R$ 129,90 quando não se atinge o volume mínimo de vendas. Há valores reduzidos na página específica: R$ 50 a partir de R$ 10 mil em vendas mensais, R$ 10 a partir de R$ 30 mil e gratuidade a partir de R$ 60 mil. As páginas oficiais divergem sobre o limite de gratuidade; confirme o aplicável no simulador ou com a Getnet. Vendas de voucher (VA/VR) e Crediário não contam para a isenção.

Fontes:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly on the monthly rental and the tiered thresholds, and it correctly notes the page divergence and cites the two source URLs. All claims are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: What plans does the Payment Link have and how much do they cost?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet offers two Payment Link plans:

- **Inicial:** Free monthly plan, plus **R$ 1.00 per paid link**, charged only when the payment is approved.
- **Básico:** **R$ 28 per month**, including 60 card transactions per month; each additional transaction costs **R$ 0.50**.

The page’s simulator also shows a **1.90% rate for Mastercard and Visa**, but does not clarify how it applies to each plan.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the documented plans and prices exactly: Inicial is free with R$ 1.00 per approved paid link, and Básico is R$ 28/month with 60 included transactions and R$ 0.50 extra. It is also supported by the evidence, which explicitly states the same pricing details.

golden_repeat_items.question: What is the debit rate on the Get Clássica?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The published debit rate for Get Clássica is **from 1.69%**. It is a single rate for Mastercard, Visa, Elo, and Amex. The offer is for new customers and subject to registration analysis; existing Getnet customers should check their rate in the Getnet app.

golden_repeat_items.question: How many Pix keys can a company have?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
A company can have up to 20 Pix keys per account, according to Getnet’s public FAQ. The FAQ does not establish one combined limit across multiple accounts.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: up to 20 Pix keys per account for companies, with the 5-for-individuals distinction omitted but not required by the question. The added note about no combined limit across multiple accounts is supported by the evidence and does not conflict with the reference.

golden_repeat_items.question: What is a chargeback?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
A chargeback (sales dispute) is when the bank cancels a card transaction and debits the merchant. Examples include a cardholder not recognizing the purchase, goods not arriving or being defective, a duplicate charge, an unprocessed refund, or the customer paying another way. For card-not-present transactions, cancellation may occur even if the merchant provides proof of the transaction.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference definition and examples, including the bank canceling the transaction and debiting the merchant. The extra detail about card-not-present transactions is supported by the evidence and remains relevant.

golden_repeat_items.question: On the Get Smart, why would a second identical sale be cancelled automatically?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
On Get Smart, a second sale is automatically cancelled if it is made within 5 minutes of the first and uses the same card, card brand, and amount. To avoid this, wait 5 minutes before retrying or use a different amount. The FAQ does not explain how to reverse a sale that has already been cancelled or whether exceptions apply.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cómo creo un Link de Pago?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Puedes crear un Link de Pago en el Portal Minha Conta iniciando sesión con tu usuario y contraseña, o desde la app Getnet Brasil. En la app, ve a **Produtos e Serviços > Link de Pagamento > Criar Link de Pagamento**. Completa los datos del producto, el envío y las opciones de pago; luego copia o comparte el enlace con tu cliente. También puedes incluir varios productos en un mismo carrito, añadir el envío al cobro y personalizar el enlace con una imagen del producto.

Fuente: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: La respuesta reproduce exactamente el flujo documentado: Portal Minha Conta o app Getnet Brasil, ruta de menú, completar datos del producto/envío/opciones de pago y luego compartir o copiar el link. Además, la información extra sobre carrito, imagen y envío está respaldada por la evidencia.

golden_repeat_items.question: What is the Getnet ombudsman phone number and when is it open?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet’s Ombudsman (Ouvidoria) can be reached at **0800 646 3404**. It is open **Monday to Friday, 9:15 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., except holidays**.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer exactly matches the reference: the ombudsman number is 0800 646 3404 and hours are Monday to Friday from 9:15 to 17:30, except holidays. The evidence directly supports both details.

golden_repeat_items.question: Em quanto tempo recebo uma venda no Pix?

O prazo pode variar em até 1 dia corrido, conforme o modelo de Pix para o qual você está habilitado e o horário em que a venda é aprovada. A Getnet também divulga recebimento “em segundos”. Mantenha seus dados cadastrais atualizados.

golden_repeat_items.question: Como faço o teste de comunicação na maquininha?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Na maquininha, pressione a tecla de função (F, # ou outra, conforme o modelo), digite **60**, escolha **2 — Manutenção** e depois **1 — Teste de comunicação**. A tecla de função varia conforme o modelo.

Fonte: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

golden_repeat_items.question: Minha maquininha está online?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Não. Sua maquininha Get Smart está offline (status `OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT`). Para tentar reconectar, siga estes passos, nesta ordem: 1) reinicie a maquininha e aguarde o indicador de rede; 2) se houver Wi‑Fi disponível, conecte-a à rede da loja; 3) desligue o terminal, retire e recoloque o chip SIM e ligue-o novamente; 4) faça o teste de comunicação: pressione a tecla de função (F, # ou equivalente, conforme o modelo), digite 60, selecione 2 (manutenção) e depois 1 (teste de comunicação). Se continuar offline tanto na rede móvel quanto no Wi‑Fi após esses passos, peça aqui para encaminharmos o caso a um especialista.

Sources:
- internal://support-runbook
- https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: A resposta diz corretamente que a maquininha não está online e identifica o status OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT. Também traz os passos de reconexão e a escalada se continuar offline, tudo समर्थado pela evidência.

golden_repeat_items.question: What is my terminal's connectivity status right now, and how long should I charge the Get Smart battery?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Your Get Smart terminal (POS-GS-99812) is currently **OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**; no connectivity timestamp is available. This means its mobile-data session stalled. Troubleshooting guidance, in order: restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator; if Wi‑Fi is available, connect to the store Wi‑Fi; turn the terminal off, reseat the SIM, then turn it back on; finally run a communication test by pressing the function key (F, #, or another key depending on the model), then 60 → 2 (maintenance) → 1 (communication test). If it remains offline on both mobile data and Wi‑Fi after these steps, ask for a human specialist to help with a chip or terminal swap.

Charge the Get Smart battery for **at least 3 hours continuously**. Recharge it when it reaches 20%, and avoid letting it fully discharge.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/ ; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/ ; internal://support-runbook

judge.rationale: The answer states the exact terminal status from the evidence and includes the battery-charge guidance from the FAQ. Its troubleshooting additions are supported by the evidence, though the user only asked for status and charge time.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
The Get Smart credit rate for 6 installments is **from 9.94%**, for Mastercard, Visa, Elo, and Amex sales received in Get Conta. judge_input.conversation:
merchant: O que é o Get Conta?
assistant: O Get Conta é a conta digital da Getnet. Ela permite receber pagamentos em uma mesma conta, acompanhar a operação pelo app Getnet Brasil, usar um cartão virtual grátis e acessar a antecipação de recebíveis. A página não publica tarifa de manutenção.

O que é o Get Conta?
Preciso já ter um produto Getnet para abrir?
O Get Conta é a conta digital da Getnet. Ela permite receber pagamentos em uma mesma conta, acompanhar a operação pelo app Getnet Brasil, usar um cartão virtual grátis e acessar a antecipação de recebíveis. A página não publica tarifa de manutenção.

Para cadastro, são usados CPF ou CNPJ, e não é necessário já ter outro produto Getnet. A abertura é feita escolhendo uma maquininha, link de pagamento ou Get Tap pelo site, WhatsApp ou telefone.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o status da minha maquininha?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Não consigo consultar o status da sua maquininha sem acesso à sua conta. Faça login no Portal Minha Conta ou no app Getnet Brasil para verificar as informações disponíveis. A FAQ não informa um procedimento específico para consultar o status do equipamento. Se precisar de ajuda, ligue para 4002-4000 ou 4003-4000 (capitais e regiões metropolitanas), ou 0800-648-8000 (demais localidades), das 06h às 22h; também há atendimento pelo WhatsApp 11 97694-6815.

Fonte: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer correctly says the status can’t be checked without account access and directs the user to log in to Portal Minha Conta or the Getnet Brasil app. It also matches the support channels and hours from the evidence, and avoids claiming a public status-tracking procedure that the evidence says is not documented.

As páginas consultadas divergem sobre a isenção do aluguel: uma informa vendas de R$ 10 mil/mês e outra, R$ 20 mil/mês; vendas de VA/VR e Crediário não contam para essa isenção. Confirme o limite aplicável no simulador ou com a Getnet.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it says no purchase price is published, gives the published monthly rental of R$ 79,90, and notes the sales-volume discrepancy plus the VA/VR and Crediário exclusion. All claims are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: If a customer pays in 3 installments or 12 installments on the Get Clássica, what are Getnet's published rates?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Get Clássica’s published starting rates for installment credit are **8.47% for 3 installments** and **12.88% for 12 installments**. The listed single rates apply to Mastercard, Visa, Elo, and Amex. They are “from” rates; the offer is for new customers, subject to registration analysis, and existing Getnet customers are directed to simulate their rates in the Getnet app.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer exactly matches the reference rates for 3x and 12x on Get Clássica and includes the published qualifiers supported by the evidence. It is directly responsive and actionable, with no unsupported claims.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é a diferença de prazo de recebimento e número máximo de parcelas entre o Parcelado Lojista e o Parcelado Emissor na Getnet?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
No **Parcelado Emissor**, você recebe o valor de uma só vez, entre **2 e 31 dias**, conforme o plano, e pode oferecer até **24 parcelas**. No **Parcelado Lojista**, a primeira parcela é recebida em **D+31** e as seguintes a cada **30 dias**; são permitidas até **12 parcelas**.

Fonte: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: A resposta corresponde exatamente ao que a referência pede: indica que o Parcelado Emissor recebe de uma vez entre 2 e 31 dias e vai até 24 parcelas, enquanto o Parcelado Lojista começa em D+31, segue a cada 30 dias e vai até 12 parcelas. A fonte citada também está presente na evidência.

Getnet permite cobrar con Pix de cuatro maneras: por aproximación, por biometría (novedad), con Get Tap en el teléfono y mediante código QR en la maquininha. Pix está disponible en maquininhas, link de pagamento, Get Tap, e-commerce y TEF.

Fuentes: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it lists the four Pix acceptance methods and the five supported Getnet solutions. The evidence explicitly supports both the methods and the availability list, including the source URL.

golden_repeat_items.question: Does the Get Smart have a kiosk mode for self-service totems, and can it integrate with store checkout automation via TEF?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Yes. Get Smart has a **Kiosk mode** designed for self-service totems: it runs one app at a time, keeps the screen on, and is password protected. It also offers **POS TEF Digital**, which integrates with store checkout automation. The published information does not specify setup steps, compatible automation systems, or additional technical requirements.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the evidence exactly: Get Smart has Kiosk mode suitable for self-service totems and POS TEF Digital integrated with checkout automation. It also correctly notes that published details do not specify setup steps or technical requirements.

golden_repeat_items.question: Who is eligible for the Get Clássica offer (customer types and annual revenue cap), and how fast do prepaid card sales settle?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The Get Clássica offer is for new customers who are individuals, MEI, or companies with annual revenue of up to R$3 million, subject to registration analysis. Existing Getnet customers should simulate rates in the Getnet app.

Prepaid-card sales settle in up to 2 business days for credit and up to 1 business day for debit.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on eligibility, the R$ 3 million annual revenue cap, and prepaid settlement times. All claims are supported by the evidence, though the extra source line and note about existing customers are not necessary.

On the Get Smart, the monthly rental is R$50 at R$10,000 in monthly sales and R$10 at R$30,000. VA/VR voucher transactions and Crediário sales do not count toward the sales threshold for reducing or waiving the rental.

golden_repeat_items.question: With Getnet's Payment Link, can I sell to foreign customers, put multiple items with shipping in one cart, and when does D+2 settlement become available?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Yes. Payment Link supports sales to foreign customers with an RNE identification document. You can include multiple products in one cart and include shipping in the charge. D+2 settlement becomes available after six months of using Payment Link, subject to analysis; no further eligibility criteria are specified.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on all three points: foreign customers with RNE are supported, multiple products plus shipping are allowed, and D+2 becomes available after 6 months subject to analysis. All claims are supported by the evidence and directly answer the merchant’s question.

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference: it says the site does not state a website is required and that no standard payout deadline is published, while correctly noting D+2 becomes available after 6 months subject to analysis. All claims are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o valor para comprar a Get Smart em definitivo e qual é a taxa cobrada no Pix nessa maquininha?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Não encontrei preço publicado para comprar a Get Smart em definitivo, nem uma taxa Pix publicada para essa maquininha. A Getnet confirma que é possível aceitar Pix por QR Code na máquina.

Como referência, o valor de aluguel publicado para a Get Smart é R$ 129,90 por mês sem atingir o volume mínimo. A página específica informa aluguel de R$ 50 a partir de R$ 10 mil em vendas mensais, R$ 10 a partir de R$ 30 mil e gratuidade a partir de R$ 60 mil; outra página oficial informa limites diferentes para a isenção, então confirme a condição aplicável com a Getnet.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/
https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the evidence: no published purchase price and no published Pix fee for Get Smart, while noting Pix via QR Code is supported. It also correctly cites the rental amounts and flags the conflicting waiver thresholds from official pages.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuánto tengo que facturar al mes para quedar exento del alquiler de la Get Smart?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
La página específica de Get Smart indica que el alquiler queda gratis desde R$ 60.000 en ventas mensuales. Sin embargo, la página general de terminales menciona un umbral de R$ 40.000 o R$ 80.000; como la información oficial se contradice, confirma cuál aplica en el simulador o con Getnet. Las ventas de VA/VR y Crediário no cuentan para la exención.

https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

golden_repeat_items.question: Minhas vendas no débito de ontem vão cair hoje na conta? E sobre pré-autorização na Getnet, qual o prazo máximo para confirmar e quantas vezes dá para alterar o valor?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Sim. As vendas no débito de ontem somaram R$ 1.240,00 líquidos e estão previstas para cair hoje, 19/11, até as 14h (liquidação D+1).

Sobre a pré-autorização: o prazo máximo para confirmar é de 30 dias, e o valor pode ser alterado até 4 vezes.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Tengo Pix habilitado en mi cuenta registrada y cuál es el teléfono de soporte técnico de Getnet cuando un sistema TEF deja de funcionar?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Sí. Pix está habilitado en tu cuenta bancaria registrada de Banco Itaú, terminada en ***04-2. Las ventas Pix de ayer fueron de **R$ 410,00 netos**, con liquidación instantánea (D+0), ya acreditadas.

Si deja de funcionar un sistema TEF, llama al soporte técnico de Getnet al **4003-5025**, disponible cualquier día y a cualquier hora.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer correctly states that Pix is enabled in the registered Banco Itaú account and gives the TEF support number 4003-5025 available any day and any time. The extra sales/liquidation detail is supported by the evidence, though not needed to answer the question.

golden_repeat_items.question: E como estão o sinal 4G e o Wi-Fi dela agora?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Agora, a telemetria da Get Smart **POS-GS-99812** indica que a sessão de dados móveis está travada (**OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**; sinal 4G: “Dual-SIM 4G session stalled”) e que a interface Wi‑Fi está desativada (“Wi‑Fi interface disabled”). O runbook não esclarece separadamente esses dois rótulos. Para tentar restabelecer a conexão, na ordem: reinicie a maquininha e aguarde o indicador de rede; se houver Wi‑Fi disponível, conecte-a à rede da loja; desligue-a, retire e recoloque o chip SIM e ligue-a novamente; depois faça o teste de comunicação: pressione a tecla de função (F, # ou outra, conforme o modelo), digite 60, escolha 2 (manutenção) e depois 1 (teste de comunicação). Se continuar sem conexão tanto nos dados móveis quanto no Wi‑Fi após esses passos, peça aqui para eu encaminhar o caso a um especialista humano.

Sources: internal://support-runbook; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference: it says the 4G session is stalled/OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT and Wi‑Fi is disabled. All factual claims are supported by the evidence, and it gives a clear next step for troubleshooting.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Por qué canales puedo abrirla y cuál es el número de WhatsApp de Getnet?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Puedes abrir Get Conta eligiendo en el sitio de Getnet una maquininha u otro producto (maquininhas, Link de Pagamento o Get Tap), por WhatsApp o por teléfono. El WhatsApp indicado para solicitarla es **(11) 97694-6815**; también figura como WhatsApp de atención a clientes. La página menciona la opción telefónica, pero no publica un número específico para abrir la cuenta.

Fuentes:
https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/
https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: La respuesta coincide con la referencia al indicar los canales de apertura y el WhatsApp 11 97694-6815, y aclara correctamente que la página menciona teléfono sin publicar un número específico. Todo está sustentado por la evidencia disponible.

golden_repeat_items.question: What are the five functions included in the Get Smart 5-in-1 machine, and does it support split payments at transaction time?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The Get Smart’s five functions are a payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, fiscal-receipt printer, and integrated management system. Getnet describes physical split and marketplace functionality for companies, with commission and tip modules, where the split occurs at transaction time. The page does not clarify whether this means splitting one purchase across cards or payment methods, or whether the split is handled directly on the terminal.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on the five functions and correctly says split payments are supported at transaction time. It also stays grounded in the evidence, and the extra clarification about what is not specified is supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: Como devo instalar o chip Algar na maquininha da Getnet e qual é a cobertura dele?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Para instalar o chip Algar: desligue a maquininha, abra a tampa traseira, encaixe o chip no compartimento SIM1 ou SIM2 com a parte metálica voltada para baixo, feche a tampa e ligue o aparelho. Aguarde a conexão; quando aparecer a rede 2G ou 3G, estará pronto. A tecla ou forma de desligar varia conforme o modelo.

A Getnet informa que o chip Algar é mult operadora e funciona em cobertura 2G/3G no Brasil. Não há informação disponível sobre cobertura em um endereço específico ou um mapa para verificá-la. Também não foi possível confirmar se a Getnet fornece o chip em todos os equipamentos ou se aceita chip próprio.

Fontes: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on installation steps and coverage: it says the chip is multicarrier, works on 2G/3G across Brazil, and gives the exact install procedure. It also correctly notes the lack of address-specific coverage info and that confirmation of Getnet-provided vs own chip is unavailable in the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: What are common reasons a bank triggers a chargeback on Getnet, and what happens with card-not-present sales even if the merchant proves the transaction?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Common chargeback reasons include goods not received or defective, the cardholder not recognizing the transaction, duplicate processing, a refund not being processed, or the customer having paid by another method. Getnet says card-not-present sales can still be cancelled even when the merchant proves the transaction; proof does not guarantee the chargeback will be reversed.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it lists the common chargeback reasons and correctly states that card-not-present sales can still be cancelled even if the merchant proves the transaction. The cited source URL is supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: A Get Conta oferece cartão virtual grátis e antecipação de recebíveis? Quais tipos de documento são aceitos no cadastro e em quais lojas de aplicativos o app Getnet Brasil está disponível?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Sim. A Get Conta oferece cartão virtual grátis e inclui antecipação de recebíveis entre suas funcionalidades. Para o cadastro, são indicados CPF para pessoa física e CNPJ para empresa. O app Getnet Brasil está disponível no Google Play e na App Store.

A publicação não detalha as condições da antecipação nem outros documentos além de CPF/CNPJ. Fontes: https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/; https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it says Get Conta offers a free virtual card and receivables advance, accepts CPF/CNPJ for registration, and the app is on Google Play and the App Store. The extra note about missing conditions/documents is also supported by the evidence.

As páginas oficiais divergem: a página da Get Clássica informa isenção a partir de R$ 10 mil em vendas mensais, enquanto a página geral de maquininhas informa R$ 20 mil. As vendas de voucher (VA/VR) e Crediário não contam para a isenção. Como não há um valor único consistente publicado, confirme o limite aplicável no simulador ou com a Getnet. Se não atingir o volume mínimo, o aluguel informado para a Get Clássica é de R$ 79,90 por mês.

golden_repeat_items.answer:

golden_repeat_items.question: If my store sells R$ 30,000 a month on it, what does that rental drop to, and how many units of it can I operate in one store?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
At R$30,000 in monthly sales, the Get Smart product page lists the rental as **R$10 per month**. Getnet’s pages conflict on the rental thresholds, so confirm the applicable condition in Getnet’s simulator or with Getnet. Sales from VA/VR vouchers and Crediário do not count toward the rental waiver. You can operate **up to 5 Get Smart devices in one store**.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer correctly states the R$10 monthly rental at R$30,000 sales and the maximum of 5 devices per store. It also remains grounded in the evidence and directly answers the merchant's question.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuánto puede variar el plazo para recibir una venta hecha con ese medio, y cuántas claves permite para personas físicas y para empresas?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
El plazo para recibir una venta con Pix puede variar hasta un día corrido, según el modelo Pix para el que seas elegible y la hora de aprobación de la venta; Getnet también lo anuncia como recepción “en segundos”. Las claves Pix permitidas son hasta 5 por cuenta para personas físicas y 20 para empresas.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: settlement can vary by up to one calendar day, and Pix keys are up to 5 for individuals and 20 for companies. The only source cited is the Getnet Pix page, which is the supported evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: For the Get Clássica card machine, what are the published installment credit rates for 4x, 7x, and 10x, and do those rates apply if I am already a Getnet customer?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The published installment credit rates for the Get Clássica are **8.96% for 4x, 10.43% for 7x, and 11.90% for 10x**. These are “from” rates, published as a single rate for Mastercard, Visa, Elo, and Amex. The offer is for new customers and is subject to registration analysis; if you are already a Getnet customer, the page says to simulate your rates in the Getnet app, so it does not confirm that these published rates apply to you.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly on the three rates and correctly states that the published rates are for new customers only, while existing Getnet customers must simulate in the app. All claims are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: En el Link de Pagamento de Getnet, ¿cuánto cuesta al mes el plan Básico, cuántas transacciones con tarjeta incluye, cuánto cobra por transacción extra y se puede incluir el envío (frete) en el cobro?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
El plan Básico cuesta **R$ 28 al mes**, incluye **60 transacciones con tarjeta al mes** y cobra **R$ 0,50 por cada transacción adicional**. Sí, puedes incluir el frete en el cobro al completar los datos del producto y del envío al crear el enlace.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: R$ 28/month, 60 card transactions, R$ 0,50 per extra transaction, and yes, frete can be included. All claims are supported by the evidence from Getnet's Payment Link page.

golden_repeat_items.question: What does the Getnet FAQ recommend for charging the Get Smart battery (when to charge, for how long, and what to avoid), and what are the different ways to power a Getnet card machine on or off?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The Getnet FAQ recommends charging the Get Smart when the battery reaches 20%, for at least 3 consecutive hours, and avoiding letting it discharge completely.

To turn a Getnet card machine on or off, the FAQ lists these methods, depending on the model: use the green key, the up-arrow key, the plug, or hold the green/red key for 5 seconds. It does not specify which method applies to each model.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the FAQ guidance in the evidence: charge at 20%, for at least 3 hours/consecutive hours, and do not let it fully discharge. It also correctly lists the model-dependent power methods and notes the FAQ does not map them to specific models.

golden_repeat_items.question: With Getnet Crediário, who decides the maximum installment term and interest rate and approves the sale, how does the merchant get paid (timing and whether it arrives in a single lump sum), and do Crediário sales count toward the card machine rental waiver?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The card issuer determines the maximum installment term and interest rate and approves each sale. Crediário allows up to 48 installments; the machine simulation shows the interest. The merchant is paid in a single payment, regardless of the installment count, within up to 2 business days after capture, net of the discount rate. Crediário sales do not count toward the card machine rental waiver.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on all requested points: issuer sets the term and rate and approves the sale, payment is within up to 2 business days after capture in a single lump sum net of the discount rate, and Crediário sales do not count toward the rental waiver. golden_repeat_items.question: Na Get Smart, como funciona o Modo Quiosque (o que ele faz na tela, quantos apps roda e como é protegido) e como funciona o split físico para empresas (quais módulos inclui e em que momento a divisão acontece)?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Na Get Smart, o **Modo Quiosque** mantém a tela sempre ligada, executa **um aplicativo por vez** e é protegido por senha; é indicado para totens de autoatendimento.

Para empresas, o **split físico** inclui os módulos de **comissão** e **gorjeta**. A divisão dos valores ocorre **no momento da transação**.

Fonte: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: A resposta corresponde ao trecho de referência: o Modo Quiosque mantém a tela sempre ligada, roda um app por vez e é protegido por senha, e o split físico inclui comissão e gorjeta com divisão no momento da transação. A URL informada também coincide com a fonte evidenciada.

golden_repeat_items.question: On Getnet's official Pix page, what are the step-by-step activation instructions for Pix and what are the published Pix transaction fees?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet’s official Pix page does not publish step-by-step activation instructions or Pix transaction fees. Its only related advice is to keep your registration data with Getnet up to date; the page does not state that this activates Pix. It describes ways to accept Pix—by approximation, biometrics, Get Tap on a phone, or QR Code on a card machine—and the channels where Pix is available, but these are not activation steps.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

O ID do terminal é **POS-GS-99812** e o modelo é **Get Smart**. No diagnóstico mais recente, o **4G está com a sessão Dual-SIM travada** (status geral `OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT`) e a **interface Wi-Fi está desativada**.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
Ayer, 18/11/2026, vendiste R$ 410,00 por Pix (R$ 410,00 netos). Se acreditó en el ciclo D+0, de forma instantánea. El depósito se realiza en Banco Itaú (341), cuenta terminada en 04-2.

Sí: el Link de Pagamento de Getnet incluye antifraude, permite vender a extranjeros identificados con RNE y admite varios productos en el mismo carrito. La página no especifica un límite máximo de productos por carrito ni condiciones adicionales para ventas a extranjeros con RNE.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the documented Pix amount, D+0 settlement, Banco Itaú ending 04-2, and the Getnet Link features exactly. All claims are supported by the evidence, and it directly answers both parts of the merchant's question.

golden_repeat_items.question: And how do I install it in the card machine?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
To install the Algar SIM in the machine:
1. Turn the machine off and open the back cover.
2. Insert the chip into the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, with the metal side facing down.
3. Close the cover, turn the machine on, and wait for the data connection. When the 2G or 3G indicator appears, it is ready.

The instructions don’t specify compatible machine models, so check that your device has a SIM1/SIM2 slot. The power-on method varies by model.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference installation steps and readiness condition, and its extra note that model compatibility isn’t specified and power-on varies by model is supported by the evidence. It directly answers the merchant’s question with actionable instructions.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
Las ventas de días anteriores en la Get Smart se cancelan únicamente por teléfono; no se hacen desde el menú de la maquininha. Llama al 4003-4000. La información consultada no especifica el plazo máximo para solicitar la cancelación ni pasos distintos según sea crédito o débito; confírmalo al llamar.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
Se aprobó el rekeying remoto de las claves del PIN-pad para la maquininha POS-GS-99812. Se creó la orden de servicio SO-81A0AE95; el trabajo está programado dentro de las próximas 2 horas de hoy, pero todavía no se ha realizado.

La venta TX-88410 por R$ 430,00 fue rechazada con ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE / POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN, asociado a una desincronización de las claves del PIN-pad. Mientras se completa la corrección, pueden seguir vendiendo con Pix o Payment Link.

guard.reason: The message asks for general guidance about chargebacks and disputing one, with no request involving another merchant, illicit activity, or instruction override.

items.answer:
A chargeback (sales dispute) is when the bank cancels a transaction and debits the merchant. Examples include goods not received or defective, a cardholder not recognizing the transaction, duplicate processing, a refund not being processed, or the customer paying another way. Getnet also warns that card-not-present sales may be cancelled even if you prove the transaction.

The available Getnet information does not specify a merchant dispute process, deadline, required documents, or where evidence must be submitted. Check the instructions on your specific notice and contact Getnet promptly to confirm the deadline and submission method: 4002-4000 or 4003-4000 in capitals/metropolitan regions; 0800-648-8000 elsewhere; or WhatsApp at 11 97694-6815. Phone service is available 06:00–22:00. You can also use Portal Minha Conta or the Getnet Brasil app; the published information does not confirm whether these channels accept chargeback evidence.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

gate_rule: Golden metrics are gated over every run of --repeat N (ADR-0019): a floor holds when the mean of the runs reaches it and no single run is more than one item below it; a ceiling holds only if every run is within it. Every other suite runs once and is gated on that run.
